There are a few beginner programs it depends how much you want to "bulk up" and what you want to focus on. If you want to get back to powerlifting then the standard Starting Strength or Strong Lifts 5x5 is probably the best choice. If you want to follow a more aesthetic route then you can do a PPL routine or follow something like StrongCurves.

Ever since I started hitting the gym (~5 months now) I'm getting these hard bumps (callus?) on my hands, especially on the base of my middle finger and my proximal phalanx. I've been using fingerless gloves for a while but this doesn't seem to work as good as intended. Anybody got any tips to prevent this?

I had those for a long time, and eventually they all got big and anoying.

I'd bet you're gripping too far back in your hand when you pull and the weights. Even with a solid grip, heavy things are going to push your skin around and cause those callouses.

The solution in that case is just to grip closer to the fingers. For me I put whatever I'm holding along the row of knuckles, or as far forward as I can be in other words.

Hope that leads somewhere helpful for you.
